items.en: Although digital platforms can make learning materials more accessible, students who lack reliable internet connections may still struggle to participate in courses that require frequent online discussion and immediate feedback.
items.zh: 虽然数字平台能让学习资料更易获取，但缺乏可靠网络连接的学生，可能仍难以参与那些要求频繁在线讨论和即时反馈的课程。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: students may still struggle to participate in courses：学生可能仍难以参与课程；may 表示可能性。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Although 引导让步状语从句；who lack reliable internet connections 修饰 students；that require frequent online discussion and immediate feedback 修饰 courses。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: make learning materials more accessible 为“使学习资料更易获取”；先译让步背景，再把两个定语从句分别放到“学生”和“课程”之前。

items.en: Urban trees, which provide shade and support local wildlife, can reduce the need for cooling in nearby buildings because they limit the amount of direct sunlight reaching exterior walls.
items.zh: 城市树木能提供树荫，并为当地野生动物提供生存条件；它们还可以减少附近建筑的制冷需求，因为它们减少了直射到外墙上的阳光。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: Urban trees can reduce the need for cooling：城市树木可以减少制冷需求；in nearby buildings 限定需求发生的位置。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明 Urban trees 的作用；because 引导原因状语从句，they 指这些树木。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: reaching exterior walls 是修饰 direct sunlight 的现在分词短语，不是独立谓语；support local wildlife 在此指为野生动物生存提供支持。

items.en: When small businesses share delivery services, they can lower transport costs and reach customers who live beyond the neighbourhoods that each business could previously serve on its own.
items.zh: 当小企业共享配送服务时，它们可以降低运输成本，并把服务范围扩展到各家企业原先独自能够覆盖的社区之外的顾客。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: they can lower transport costs and reach customers：它们可以降低成本并服务更多顾客；lower 与 reach 是并列谓语动词。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: When 引导时间状语从句；who live beyond the neighbourhoods 修饰 customers；that each business could previously serve on its own 进一步修饰 neighbourhoods。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 从里向外处理嵌套修饰：先理解“各企业原先独自能服务的社区”，再理解“住在这些社区之外的顾客”；reach 在此指业务覆盖。

items.en: Museums whose collections reflect everyday life can broaden public understanding of history if they explain how ordinary objects were used, rather than simply displaying them as attractive items from the past.
items.zh: 馆藏反映日常生活的博物馆，如果能解释普通物件过去如何被使用，而不只是将其作为好看的旧物陈列，就能拓宽公众对历史的理解。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: Museums can broaden public understanding of history：博物馆可以拓宽公众对历史的理解。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: whose collections reflect everyday life 修饰 Museums，whose 表示所属关系；if 引导条件状语从句；how ordinary objects were used 作 explain 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: rather than 表示“而不是”；them 指 ordinary objects；collections 在博物馆语境中译为“馆藏”，不译为“收集行为”。

items.en: Before a new water filter is introduced, researchers must test whether it can remove harmful substances under the varied conditions that households are likely to encounter in daily use.
items.zh: 在推出一种新的净水过滤器之前，研究人员必须检验：在家庭日常使用时可能遇到的各种条件下，它是否能去除有害物质。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: researchers must test whether ...：研究人员必须检验某种能力是否成立；must 表示必要性。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Before 引导时间状语从句；whether it can remove harmful substances 引导宾语从句；that households are likely to encounter in daily use 修饰 conditions。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: whether 译为“是否”，不要当成条件“如果”；under the varied conditions 表示去除有害物质时所处的不同条件。

items.en: Only when students are encouraged to explain why an answer is wrong can teachers assess whether the class has understood the underlying principle rather than merely memorised a familiar procedure.
items.zh: 只有鼓励学生解释某个答案为什么错误，教师才能判断全班是否理解了背后的原理，而非只是记住了一套熟悉的步骤。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: 还原主句语序为 teachers can assess whether ...；Only 加状语置于句首，使主句出现 can teachers 的部分倒装。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: when students are encouraged to explain ... 引导时间状语从句；why an answer is wrong 作 explain 的宾语；whether the class has understood ... 作 assess 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: Only when ... can ... 译为“只有……才……”；understood 与 memorised 共享 has，rather than 区分真正理解和机械记忆。

items.en: What makes a public transport system attractive is not simply how fast individual vehicles travel, but whether passengers can rely on frequent services that connect the places they actually need to reach.
items.zh: 公共交通系统的吸引力，不只是来自单个交通工具行驶得有多快，还在于乘客能否依靠班次频繁的服务，到达他们真正需要去的地方。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: What makes a public transport system attractive 是主语，is 是系动词；后面的 not simply ... but ... 连接两个表语部分。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: What 引导主语从句并在其中作主语；how fast ... 与 whether ... 都作表语；that connect the places 修饰 services；they actually need to reach 是省略关系词的定语从句，修饰 places。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 按“不只是……还在于……”展开对照；frequent services 指公共交通班次频繁，不是抽象的“经常服务”。

items.en: Not until local residents were invited to contribute their own stories did the archive begin to reveal how a shared industrial past had shaped the identities of different generations within the community.
items.zh: 直到当地居民受邀讲述自己的故事，这座档案馆才开始揭示：共同的工业历史如何塑造了社区内不同代际人群的身份认同。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: 还原为 the archive did not begin to reveal ... until ...；Not until 结构前置后，主句用 did the archive begin 的部分倒装。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: until local residents were invited ... 引导时间状语从句，本身不倒装；how a shared industrial past had shaped ... 作 reveal 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: Not until ... did ... 译为“直到……才……”；had shaped 表示塑造过程早于档案馆开始揭示这一情况。

items.en: While some students prefer to study alone, others learn more effectively in groups where they can compare explanations and ask questions without feeling that every mistake will be formally assessed.
items.zh: 有些学生喜欢独自学习，而另一些学生在小组中学得更有效；在小组里，他们可以比较不同解释、提出问题，而不必觉得每一个错误都会被正式评判。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: others learn more effectively in groups：另一些学生在小组中学得更有效；others 与前面的 some students 对照。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: While 在这里引导表示对比的从句，意为“而”；where 引导定语从句，修饰 groups；that every mistake will be formally assessed 作 feeling 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: where 可理解为 in which；without feeling ... 表示没有这种心理压力，不代表原文保证学习完全没有评价。

items.en: Although a subsidy may encourage households to purchase efficient appliances, its environmental benefit depends on whether total energy consumption falls after people begin using the cheaper technology more frequently.
items.zh: 虽然补贴可能鼓励家庭购买节能电器，但其环境效益取决于：当人们开始更频繁地使用这种成本更低的技术后，能源总消耗量是否下降。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: its environmental benefit depends on whether ...：其环境效益取决于某种情况是否发生；its 指补贴所带来的。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Although 引导让步状语从句；whether total energy consumption falls ... 作介词 on 的宾语；after people begin ... 在 whether 从句中作时间状语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 注意 total energy consumption 指能源总消耗量；单件电器高效，并不自动等于总耗能下降，翻译须保留这一对照。

items.en: If the city had protected the wetlands that once surrounded its suburbs, it might have suffered less flood damage during the storm, even though the rainfall was unusually heavy.
items.zh: 如果这座城市当初保护了曾环绕其郊区的湿地，那么尽管那场暴风雨的降雨量异常大，它遭受的洪灾损失也可能更小。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: it might have suffered less flood damage：它本可能遭受较小的洪灾损失；might have done 表示对过去情况的假设结果。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: If the city had protected ... 是与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句；that once surrounded its suburbs 修饰 wetlands；even though 引导让步状语从句。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 用“如果当初……本可能……”保留反事实含义；原句假设的是保护湿地及其效果，并未把降雨异常大也说成假设。

items.en: Not only does open access allow more readers to examine a study, but it also makes it easier for independent researchers to question assumptions that may have escaped the original review.
items.zh: 开放获取不仅让更多读者能够审视一项研究，也使独立研究人员更容易质疑那些可能在最初评审中被忽略的假设。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: 两个分句为 open access allows more readers to examine a study 和 it also makes it easier ...；Not only 前置使第一分句用 does ... allow 倒装，第二分句保持正常语序。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: that may have escaped the original review 是定语从句，修饰 assumptions；may have escaped 表示这些假设过去可能未被注意到。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: but 后第一个 it 指 open access；makes 后的 it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语内容是 for independent researchers to question assumptions ...。

items.en: Although academic rankings offer a convenient comparison, they may overlook forms of teaching that support students whose progress cannot be adequately represented by a single numerical indicator.
items.zh: 虽然学术排名便于比较，但它们可能忽视某些支持学生发展的教学方式，而这些学生的进步无法由单一的数字指标充分体现。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: they may overlook forms of teaching：这些排名可能忽视某些教学方式；they 指 academic rankings。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Although 引导让步状语从句；that support students 修饰 forms of teaching；whose progress cannot be adequately represented ... 修饰 students，whose 表示所属关系。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 先确定“教学方式支持学生”的关系，再处理“学生的进步难以量化”；cannot be adequately represented 是“无法充分体现”，不是“毫无体现”。

items.en: What the experiment establishes is that the two variables change together under specified conditions, not that one necessarily causes the other or that the relationship will persist in different populations.
items.zh: 实验所证实的是，这两个变量在规定条件下共同变化，而不是其中一个必然导致另一个，也不是这种关系会在不同人群中持续存在。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: What the experiment establishes 作主语，is 作系动词；肯定的表语内容与 not 后否定的两项内容形成对照。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: What 引导主语从句，并在其中作 establishes 的宾语；三个 that 从句均属于表语部分，后两个由 or 连接并受 not 否定。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: not that ... or that ... 应译清楚两项都未获证实；共同变化不等于因果关系，也不保证能推广到不同人群。

items.en: Only if policymakers distinguish temporary fluctuations from persistent structural change can they justify interventions whose immediate costs are visible but whose long-term benefits depend on conditions that remain difficult to predict.
items.zh: 只有政策制定者区分了短期波动与持续的结构性变化，才能证明某些干预措施具有合理性；这些措施的即时成本显而易见，但长期收益取决于仍难预测的条件。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: 还原为 they can justify interventions；Only if 条件状语前置，触发 can they 的部分倒装。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: if 引导条件状语从句；whose immediate costs are visible 与 whose long-term benefits depend on conditions 并列修饰 interventions；that remain difficult to predict 修饰 conditions。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: Only if 表示必要条件“只有……才……”，不等于 if only“要是……就好了”；长定语可拆成分句，保留成本与收益的对照。

items.en: Since ecosystems respond to several pressures at once, conservation programmes should consider how changes in land use interact with the climatic conditions that influence the survival of local species.
items.zh: 由于生态系统会同时对多种压力作出反应，保护项目应考虑土地利用变化如何与影响当地物种生存的气候条件相互作用。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: conservation programmes should consider how ...：保护项目应考虑某种相互作用；should 表示建议或应然要求。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Since 引导原因状语从句，不表示“自从”；how changes in land use interact ... 作 consider 的宾语；that influence the survival of local species 修饰 climatic conditions。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: interact with 表示双方相互作用；at once 在此表示“同时”，不是要求行动“立刻”发生。

items.en: It is the process through which communities negotiate the meaning of their traditions, rather than the preservation of every inherited practice, that may sustain cultural continuity when social circumstances change.
items.zh: 当社会环境发生变化时，可能维系文化延续的，是社区协商其传统意义的过程，而不是保留每一项传承下来的做法。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: 这是 It is ... that ... 强调句，强调主语 the process；去掉强调框架后为 the process ... may sustain cultural continuity。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: through which communities negotiate the meaning of their traditions 是修饰 process 的定语从句；when social circumstances change 是时间状语从句。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: rather than 引出与 process 对比的名词短语；强调句中的 that 不要误判为修饰 practice 的关系代词；may 的不确定语气必须保留。

items.en: Were researchers to exclude every observation that contradicts their preferred model, they would produce a misleading explanation whose apparent coherence would conceal the uncertainty that rigorous investigation should acknowledge.
items.zh: 假如研究人员排除所有与其偏好的模型相矛盾的观察结果，他们就会得出一种误导性的解释；这种解释表面上的连贯性会掩盖严谨研究本应承认的不确定性。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: they would produce a misleading explanation：他们就会得出误导性的解释；would 表明这是设想条件下的结果。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Were researchers to exclude ... 相当于 If researchers were to exclude ...，是省略 if 的虚拟条件倒装；第一个 that 从句修饰 observation；whose 从句修饰 explanation；最后一个 that 从句修饰 uncertainty。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: Were ... to ... 不表示这里已经发生了过去事件；apparent coherence 是“表面上的连贯性”，需与 misleading 的负面评价一并理解。

items.en: Whether a financial incentive changes behaviour depends partly on whether people regard the reward as fair and whether the action it encourages fits the practical constraints of their daily lives.
items.zh: 经济激励是否会改变行为，部分取决于人们是否认为奖励公平，以及它所鼓励的行为是否符合人们日常生活中的实际限制条件。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: Whether a financial incentive changes behaviour 是主语，depends partly on 是谓语核心；主语从句整体按单数处理。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: 第一个 whether 引导主语从句；后两个 whether 从句并列作 on 的宾语；it encourages 是省略关系词的定语从句，修饰 action，it 指 incentive。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 三个 whether 都译为“是否”；regard A as B 是“把 A 视为 B”；partly 限定论断，说明这些并非全部影响因素。

items.en: Even if a technology reduces emissions during operation, its overall environmental value remains uncertain unless the resources consumed in production and disposal are also assessed, an assessment that requires evidence across its entire life cycle.
items.zh: 即使某项技术在运行期间减少了排放，若不同时评估其生产和处置环节消耗的资源，其总体环境价值仍不确定；这项评估需要覆盖其整个生命周期的证据。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: its overall environmental value remains uncertain：其总体环境价值仍不确定；remains 是系动词，uncertain 是表语。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Even if 引导让步条件状语从句；unless 引导条件状语从句；that requires evidence across its entire life cycle 修饰 assessment。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: consumed in production and disposal 是修饰 resources 的过去分词短语；an assessment 是对前述评估行为的补充说明；unless 可译成“若不……则……”。

items.en: However persuasive an interpretation may appear, its credibility depends less on the confidence with which it is presented than on whether competing explanations have been subjected to equally careful scrutiny.
items.zh: 无论一种解释看起来多么有说服力，其可信度与其说取决于提出它时有多自信，不如说取决于其他竞争性解释是否也经过了同样细致的审查。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: its credibility depends less on A than on B：其可信度对 A 的依赖少于对 B 的依赖；A 是 confidence，B 是 whether 从句。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: However persuasive an interpretation may appear 是让步状语从句，相当于 no matter how persuasive ...；with which it is presented 修饰 confidence；whether 从句作第二个 on 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: However 在此不是转折副词“然而”；less ... than ... 可译为“与其说……不如说……”；be subjected to scrutiny 是“接受审查”。

items.en: Historical accounts reflect the concerns of the societies in which they were written because authors decide which events deserve attention and which details can be left outside the narrative.
items.zh: 历史叙述反映了其写作所处社会关注的问题，因为作者会决定哪些事件值得关注，以及哪些细节可以不纳入叙述。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: Historical accounts reflect the concerns of the societies：历史叙述反映相关社会关注的问题；accounts 在此不是“账户”。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: in which they were written 是修饰 societies 的定语从句，they 指 accounts；because 引导原因状语从句；which events ... 与 which details ... 是并列的宾语从句，作 decide 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 区分关系结构 in which 和表示“哪些”的 which events、which details；be left outside the narrative 可自然译为“不纳入叙述”。

items.en: The assumption that greater institutional autonomy inevitably improves educational quality has been challenged by researchers who argue that autonomy produces different outcomes depending on how funding and public accountability are organised.
items.zh: 更大的机构自主权必然提高教育质量这一假设受到了研究人员的质疑；他们认为，自主权产生的结果会因经费安排和公共问责机制的组织方式而异。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: The assumption has been challenged by researchers：这一假设受到了研究人员的质疑；has been challenged 是现在完成时的被动语态。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: 第一个 that 从句说明 assumption 的具体内容，是同位语从句；who argue ... 修饰 researchers；argue 后的 that 从句作宾语；how funding and public accountability are organised 作 on 的宾语。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: 第一个 that 从句结构完整，that 不充当其中的主语或宾语，不是定语从句；depending on ... 译为“取决于……”或“因……而异”。

items.en: Had the assessment included communities whose livelihoods depend on the river, the committee might have recognised that a project appearing economically efficient could nevertheless impose substantial costs on people excluded from the calculation.
items.zh: 如果当初的评估纳入了那些生计依赖这条河流的社区，委员会或许就会认识到：一个看似经济高效的项目，仍可能让被排除在测算之外的人承担巨大的成本。

analysis.label: 主干
analysis.text: the committee might have recognised that ...：委员会当时或许就会认识到某事；might have recognised 表示过去假设条件下的可能结果。

analysis.label: 从句
analysis.text: Had the assessment included ... 相当于 If the assessment had included ...，是过去虚拟条件句的倒装；whose livelihoods depend on the river 修饰 communities；that 引导 recognised 的宾语从句。

analysis.label: 翻译提示
analysis.text: appearing economically efficient 修饰 project，excluded from the calculation 修饰 people，均为分词短语；nevertheless 要译出“尽管如此仍然”的转折。

items.en: But even more important, it was the farthest that scientists had been able to look into the past, for what they were seeing were the patterns and structures that existed 15 billion years ago.
items.zh: 但更为重要的是，这是科学家们能够观测到的最遥远的过去的景象，因为他们看到的是150亿年前宇宙云的形状和结构。
items.source: 1998 考研英语 Section IV English-Chinese Translation

items.en: The existence of the giant clouds was virtually required for the Big Bang, first put forward in the 1920s, to maintain its reign as the dominant explanation of the cosmos.
items.zh: 巨大的宇宙云的存在，实际上是使20世纪20年代首创的“大爆炸论”得以保持其宇宙起源论的主导地位所不可缺少的。
items.source: 1998 考研英语 Section IV English-Chinese Translation

items.en: Astrophysicists working with ground-based detectors at the South Pole and balloon-borne instruments are closing in on such structures, and may report their findings soon.
items.zh: 天体物理学家使用南极陆基探测器和球载仪器，正在越来越近地观测这些云系，也许不久会报告他们的观测结果。
items.source: 1998 考研英语 Section IV English-Chinese Translation

items.en: If the small hot spots look as expected, that will be a triumph for yet another scientific idea, a refinement of the Big Bang called the inflationary universe theory.
items.zh: 假如这些小热点看上去同预计的一致，那就意味着又一种科学论说的胜利，这种论说即更完美的大爆炸论，亦称宇宙膨胀说。
items.source: 1998 考研英语 Section IV English-Chinese Translation

items.en: Odd though it sounds, cosmic inflation is a scientifically plausible consequence of some respected ideas in elementary particle physics, and many astrophysicists have been convinced for the better part of a decade that it is true.
items.zh: 宇宙膨胀说虽然听似奇特，但是它是基本粒子物理学中一些公认的理论产生的在科学上看来似乎可信的结论。许多天体物理学家近十年来一直确信这一论说是正确的。
items.source: 1998 考研英语 Section IV English-Chinese Translation

items.en: While there are almost as many definitions of history as there are historians, modern practice most closely conforms to one that sees history as the attempt to recreate and explain the significant events of the past.
items.zh: 几乎每个历史学家对史学都有自己的界定，但是现代史学家的实践最趋于认为历史学是试图再现过去的重大史实并对其做出解释。
items.source: 1999 考研英语 Part Ⅲ English Chinese Translation

items.en: Interest in historical methods has arisen less through external challenge to the validity of history as an intellectual discipline and more from internal quarrels among historians themselves.
items.zh: 人们之所以关注历史研究的方法论，主要是因为史学界内部意见不一，其次是因为外界并不认为历史是一门学问。
items.source: 1999 考研英语 Part Ⅲ English Chinese Translation

items.en: During this transfer, traditional historical methods were augmented by additional methodologies designed to interpret the new forms of evidence in the historical study.
items.zh: 在这种转变中，历史学家研究历史时，那些解释新史料的新方法充实了传统的历史研究方法。
items.source: 1999 考研英语 Part Ⅲ English Chinese Translation

items.en: There is no agreement whether methodology refers to the concepts peculiar to historical work in general or to the research techniques appropriate to the various branches of historical inquiry.
items.zh: 所谓方法论是指一般的历史研究中的特有概念，还是指历史探究中各个具体领域适用的研究手段，人们对此意见不一。
items.source: 1999 考研英语 Part Ⅲ English Chinese Translation

items.en: It applies equally to traditional historians who view history as only the external and internal criticism of sources, and to social science historians who equate their activity with specific techniques.
items.zh: 这种谬误同样存在于历史传统派和历史社科派。前者认为历史就是史学界内部和外部人士对各种史料来源的评论，后者则认为历史的研究是具体方法的研究。
items.source: 1999 考研英语 Part Ⅲ English Chinese Translation

items.en: Under modern conditions, this requires varying measures of centralized control and hence the help of specialized scientists such as economists and operational research experts.
items.zh: 在现代条件下，这需要程度不同的集中控制措施，从而就需要获得诸如经济学和运筹学等领域的专家的协助。
items.source: 2000 考研英语 Part ⅢEnglish-Chinese Translation

items.en: Furthermore, it is obvious that the strength of a country’s economy is directly bound up with the efficiency of its agriculture and industry, and that this in turn rests upon the efforts of scientists and technologists of all kinds.
items.zh: 再者，显而易见的是一个国家的经济实力与其工农业生产效率密切相关，而效率的提高又有赖于各种科技人员的努力。
items.source: 2000 考研英语 Part ⅢEnglish-Chinese Translation

items.en: Owing to the remarkable development in mass-communications, people everywhere are feeling new wants and are being exposed to new customs and ideas, while governments are often forced to introduce still further innovations for the reasons given above.
items.zh: 大众通讯的显著发展使各地的人们不断感到有新的需求，不断接触到新的习俗和思想。由于上述原因，政府常常得推出更多的革新。
items.source: 2000 考研英语 Part ⅢEnglish-Chinese Translation

items.en: in the early industrialized countries of Europe the process of industrialization—with all the far-reaching changes in social patterns that followed—was spread over nearly a century, whereas nowadays a developing nation may undergo the same process in a decade or so.
items.zh: 在先期实现工业化的欧洲国家中，其工业化进程以及随之而来的各种深刻的社会结构变革，持续了大约一个世纪之久，而如今一个发展中国家在十年左右就可能完成这个过程。
items.source: 2000 考研英语 Part ⅢEnglish-Chinese Translation

items.en: Additional social stresses may also occur because of the population explosion or problems arising from mass migration movements—themselves made relatively easy nowadays by modern means of transport.
items.zh: 由于人口的猛增或人口的大量流动（现代交通工具使这种流动相对容易）造成的种种问题，也会对社会造成新的压力。
items.source: 2000 考研英语 Part ⅢEnglish-Chinese Translation

items.en: There will be television chat shows hosted by robots, and cars with pollution monitors that will disable them when they offend.
items.zh: 届时，将会出现由机器人主持的电视谈话节目和装有污染监控器的汽车；一旦这些汽车排污违规，监控器就会使其停驶。
items.source: 2001 考研英语 Part III English-Chinese Translation

items.en: Children will play with dolls equipped with personality chips, computers with in-built personalities will be regarded as workmates rather than tools, relaxation will be in front of smell television, and digital age will have arrived.
items.zh: 儿童将与装有个性化芯片的玩具娃娃玩耍，具有个性内置的计算机将被视为工作伙伴而不是工具，人们将在气味电视机前休闲，届时数字化时代就来到了。
items.source: 2001 考研英语 Part III English-Chinese Translation

items.en: Pearson has pieced together the work of hundreds of researchers around the world to produce a unique millennium technology calendar that gives the latest dates when we can expect hundreds of key breakthroughs and discoveries to take place.
items.zh: 皮尔森汇集世界各地数百位研究人员的成果，编制了一个独特的技术千年历，它列出了人们有望看到数百项重大突破和发现的最迟日期。
items.source: 2001 考研英语 Part III English-Chinese Translation

items.en: But that, Pearson points out, is only the start of man-machine integration: “It will be the beginning of the long process of integration that will ultimately lead to a fully electronic human before the end of the next century.”
items.zh: 但皮尔森指出，这个突破仅仅是人机一体化的开始：“它是人机一体化漫长之路的第一步，最终人们在下世纪末之前就研制出完全电子化的仿真人。”
items.source: 2001 考研英语 Part III English-Chinese Translation

items.en: And home appliances will also become so smart that controlling and operating them will result in the breakout of a new psychological disorder—kitchen rage.
items.zh: 家用电器将会变得如此智能化，以至于控制和操作它们会引发一种新的心理疾病——厨房狂躁症。
items.source: 2001 考研英语 Part III English-Chinese Translation

items.en: One difficulty is that almost all of what is called behavioral science continues to trace behavior to states of mind, feelings, traits of character, human nature, and so on.
items.zh: 难题之一在于所谓的行为科学几乎全都依然从心态、情感、性格特征、人性等方面去寻找行为的根源。
items.source: 2002 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The behavioral sciences have been slow to change partly because the explanatory items often seem to be directly observed and partly because other kinds of explanations have been hard to find.
items.zh: 行为科学之所以发展缓慢，部分原因是用来解释行为的依据似乎往往是直接观察到的，部分原因是其他的解释方式一直难以找到。
items.source: 2002 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The role of natural selection in evolution was formulated only a little more than a hundred years ago, and the selective role of the environment in shaping and maintaining the behavior of the individual is only beginning to be recognized and studied.
items.zh: 自然选择在进化中的作用仅在一百多年前才得以阐明，而环境在塑造、保持个体行为时的选择作用则刚刚开始被认识和研究。
items.source: 2002 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: They are the possessions of the autonomou（s self-governing）man of traditional theory, and they are essential to practices in which a person is held responsible for his conduct and given credit for his achievements.
items.zh: 它们是传统理论定义的自主人拥有的，是要求一个人对自己的行为负责并因其业绩而给予肯定的必不可少的前提。
items.source: 2002 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Until these issues are resolved, a technology of behavior will continue to be rejected, and with it possibly the only way to solve our problems.
items.zh: （如果）这些问题得不到解决，研究行为的技术手段就会继续受到排斥，解决问题的惟一方式可能也随之继续受到排斥。
items.source: 2002 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Furthermore, humans have the ability to modify the environment in which they live, thus subjecting all other life forms to their own peculiar ideas and fancies.
items.zh: 而且，人类还有能力改变自己的生存环境，从而使所有其他生命形态服从人类自己独特的想法和想象。
items.source: 2003 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Social science is that branch of intellectual enquiry which seeks to study humans and their endeavors in the same reasoned, orderly, systematic, and dispassioned manner that natural scientists use for the study of natural phenomena.
items.zh: 社会科学是知识探索的一个分支，它力图像自然科学家研究自然现象那样，以理性的、有序的、系统的、冷静的方式去研究人类及其行为。
items.source: 2003 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The emphasis on data gathered first-hand, combined with a cross-cultural perspective brought to the analysis of cultures past and present, makes this study a unique and distinctly important social science.
items.zh: 强调收集第一手资料，加上在分析过去和现在文化形态时采用跨文化视角，使得这一研究成为一门独特并且非常重要的社会科学。
items.source: 2003 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Tylor defined culture as “…that complex whole which includes belief, art, morals, law, custom, and any other capabilities and habits acquired by man as a member of society.”
items.zh: 泰勒把文化定义为“……一个复合整体，它包括人作为社会成员获得的信仰、艺术、道德、法律、风俗以及其他能力和习惯。”
items.source: 2003 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Thus, the anthropological concept of “culture,” like the concept of “set” in mathematics, is an abstract concept which makes possible immense amounts of concrete research and understanding.
items.zh: 因此，人类学中的“文化”概念就像数学中“集合”的概念一样，是一个抽象概念；它使大量的具体研究和认识成为可能。
items.source: 2003 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The Greeks assumed that the structure of language had some connection with the process of thought, which took root in Europe long before people realized how diverse languages could be.
items.zh: 希腊人认为语言的结构和思维过程有某种联系，这种观点早在人们意识到语言的千差万别之前已经在欧洲扎下了根。
items.source: 2004 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: We are obliged to them because some of these languages have since vanished, as the peoples who spoke them died out or became assimilated and lost their native languages.
items.zh: 我们得感谢他们（两位先驱），因为在此之后，这些（土著）语言中有一些已经不复存在了，这是由于说这些语言的部族或是消亡了或是被同化而丧失了自己的本族语言。
items.source: 2004 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The newly described languages were often so strikingly different from the well studied languages of Europe and Southeast Asia that some scholars even accused Boas and Sapir of fabricating their data.
items.zh: 这些新近被描绘的语言与已经得到充分研究的欧洲及东南亚地区的语言之间的区别往往如此显著，以至于有学者甚至指责博厄斯和萨皮尔编造材料。
items.source: 2004 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Being interested in the relationship of language and thought, Whorf developed the idea that the structure of language determines the structure of habitual thought in a society.
items.zh: 沃尔夫对语言和思维的关系很感兴趣，因此他逐渐形成了这样的观点：一个社会中语言的结构决定习惯思维的结构。
items.source: 2004 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Whorf came to believe in a sort of linguistic determinism which, in its strongest form, states that language imprisons the mind, and that the grammatical patterns in a language can produce far-reaching consequences for the culture of a society.
items.zh: 沃尔夫逐渐相信某种语言决定论观点，其极端的说法是：语言禁锢思想，语言的语法结构能对一个社会的文化产生深远的影响。
items.source: 2004 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Television is one of the means by which these feelings are created and conveyed – and perhaps never before has it served so much to connect different peoples and nations as in the recent events in Europe.
items.zh: 电视是引发和传递这些感受的手段之一——在欧洲近来发生的事件中，它把不同的民族和国家连在一起，其作用之大，前所未有。
items.source: 2005 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: In Europe, as elsewhere, multi-media groups have been increasingly successful; groups which bring together television, radio, newspapers, magazines and publishing houses that work in relation to one another.
items.zh: 在欧洲，像在其他地方一样，多媒体集团越来越成功；这些集团将相互关联的电视、广播、报纸、杂志和出版社组合在一起。
items.source: 2005 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: This alone demonstrates that the television business is not an easy world to survive in, a fact underlined by statistics that show that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989.
items.zh: 这一点就足以表明，要在电视行业里生存下来并非易事，统计数字尤其说明了这一事实：在80家欧洲电视网中，多达一半在1989年亏损。
items.source: 2005 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Creating a “European identity” that respects the different cultures and traditions which go to make up the connecting fabric of the Old Continent is no easy task and demands a strategic choice
items.zh: 不同的文化和传统把欧洲大陆编织成一个整体，要创造一种尊重这些不同文化和传统的“欧洲认同”绝非易事，需要人们做出战略性的选择——也就是选择在欧洲为欧洲制作节目。
items.source: 2005 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: In dealing with a challenge on such a scale, it is no exaggeration to say, “United we stand, divided we fall”
items.zh: 在应付如此规模的挑战时，可以毫不夸张地说：“联合，我们就生存；分裂，我们就灭亡。”
items.source: 2005 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: I shall define him as an individual who has elected as his primary duty and pleasure in life the activity of thinking in a Socratic(苏格拉底) way about moral problems.
items.zh: 我将他定义为一个对道德问题进行苏格拉底式思考并将此作为自己人生首要责任和快乐的人。
items.source: 2006 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision.
items.zh: 他的职责与法官相似，必须承担这样的责任：以尽可能明了的方式来展示自己作出决定的推理过程。
items.source: 2006 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: I have excluded him because, while his accomplishments may contribute to the solution of moral problems, he has not been charged with the task of approaching any but the factual aspects of those problems.
items.zh: 我之所以将他（普通科学家）排除在外，是因为尽管他的成果可能会有助于解决道德问题，但他承担的任务只不过是研究这些问题的事实方面。
items.source: 2006 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: But his primary task is not to think about the moral code which governs his activity, any more than a businessman is expected to dedicate his energies to an exploration of rules of conduct in business.
items.zh: 但是，他的首要任务并不是考虑支配自己行为的道德规范，就如同不能指望商人专注于探索行业规范一样。
items.source: 2006 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: They may teach very well, and more than earn their salaries, but most of them make little or no independent reflections on human problems which involve moral judgment.
items.zh: 他们可以教得很好，而且不仅仅是为了挣薪水，但他们大多数人却很少或没有对需要进行道德判断的人类问题进行独立思考。
items.source: 2006 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Traditionally, legal learning has been viewed in such institutions as the special preserve of lawyers, rather than a necessary part of the intellectual equipment of an educated person.
items.zh: 长期以来，在这类院校中，法律知识一直被视为律师们的专有领域，而不是一个受过教育的人在知识素养方面所必需的组成部分。
items.source: 2007 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: On the other, it links these concepts to everyday realities in a manner which is parallel to the links journalists forge on a daily basis as they cover and comment on the news.
items.zh: 另一方面，法律把这些概念同日常生活中的现实联系起来，其方式与新闻记者每天在报道和评论新闻时把这些概念与现实联系起来的方式相类似。
items.source: 2007 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: But the idea that the journalist must understand the law more profoundly than an ordinary citizen rests on an understanding of the established conventions and special responsibilities of the news media.
items.zh: 新闻记者应当比普通公民更深入地了解法律，而这一观点建立在对新闻媒体业已经确立的惯例和特殊责任的理解之上。
items.source: 2007 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: In fact, it is difficult to see how journalists who do not have a clear grasp of the basic features of the Canadian Constitution can do a competent job on political stories.
items.zh: 事实上，很难想象那些对加拿大宪法的基本特征缺乏清楚了解的新闻记者怎么能够胜任政治新闻的报道工作。
items.source: 2007 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories, it is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.
items.zh: 尽管律师的评论和反应可能会提高新闻报道的质量，但新闻记者最好还是凭借自己对重要性的理解自行作出判断。
items.source: 2007 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: he believes that this very difficulty may have had the compensating advantage of forcing him to think long and intently about every sentence, and thus enabling him to detect errors in reasoning and in his own observations.
items.zh: 他认为或许正因为(语言表达上的)这种困难，他不得不对自己要说的每句话都进行长时间的认真思考，从而能发现推理错误及自己言论中的错误，结果这反而成为他的优点。
items.source: 2008 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: He asserted, also, that his power to follow a long and purely abstract train of thought was very limited, for which reason he felt certain that he never could have succeeded with mathematics.
items.zh: 他还坚持认为自己进行长时间纯抽象思维的能力十分有限，由此他也认定自己在数学方面根本不可能有大的作为。
items.source: 2008 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: On the other hand, he did not accept as well founded the charge made by some of his critics that, while he was a good observer, he had no power of reasoning.
items.zh: 另一方面，一些批评者指责他虽然善于观察，却不具备推理能力，而他认为这种指责是缺乏根据的。
items.source: 2008 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: He adds humbly that perhaps he was “superior to the common run of men in noticing things which easily escape attention, and in observing them carefully.”
items.zh: 他又自谦地说，或许自己“在注意到容易被忽略的事物，并对其加以仔细观察方面优于常人”。
items.source: 2008 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to the moral character.
items.zh: 达尔文确信，没有了这些爱好不只是少了乐趣，而且可能会有损思维能力，更有可能导致道德品质的下降。
items.source: 2008 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It may be said that the measure of the worth of any social institution is its effect in enlarging and improving experience, but this effect is not a part of its original motive.
items.zh: 虽然我们可以说衡量任何一个社会机构价值的标准是其在丰富和完善人生经验方面所起的作用，但这种作用并不是其最初动机的组成部分。
items.source: 2009 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Only gradually was the by-product of the institution noted, and only more gradually still was this effect considered as a directive factor in the conduct of the institution.
items.zh: 人们只是逐渐地才注意到机构的这一副产品，而人们把这种作用视为机构运作的指导性因素的过程则更为缓慢。
items.source: 2009 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: While it is easy to ignore in our contact with them the effect of our acts upon their disposition, it is not so easy as in dealing with adults.
items.zh: 尽管在与年轻人的接触中我们容易忽视自己的行为对他们的性情所产生的影响，但仍比不上与成年人打交道时那样容易。
items.source: 2009 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Since our chief business with them is to enable them to share in a common life we cannot help considering whether or not we are forming the powers which will secure this ability.
items.zh: 由于我们对年轻人所做的首要工作在于使他们能够在生活中彼此相融，因此我们不禁要考虑自己是否在形成让他们获得这种能力的力量。
items.source: 2009 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: We are thus led to distinguish, within the broad educational process which we have been so far considering, a more formal kind of education – that of direct tuition or schooling.
items.zh: 这就使我们得以在一直讨论的广义的教育过程中进一步区分出一种更为正式的教育形式，即直接讲授或学校教育。
items.source: 2009 考研英语 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Scientists jumped to the rescue with some distinctly shaky evidence to the effect that insects would eat us up if birds failed to control them.
items.zh: 科学家们急忙赶来挽救，但提出的证据显然站不住脚，其大意是，如果鸟类不能控制昆虫的数量，昆虫便会吞噬我们人类。
items.source: 2010 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: but we have at least drawn nearer the point of admitting that birds should continue as a matter of intrinsic right, regardless of the presence or absence of economic advantage to us.
items.zh: 但是我们至少近乎承认，无论鸟类能否带给我们经济价值，它们自有生存下去的权利。
items.source: 2010 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on “worthless” species.
items.zh: 有证据表明：这些生物杀死体弱者来保持种群的健康，或者说它们仅仅捕食“没有价值”的物种。曾经有段时间，生物学家或多或少滥用了这一证据。
items.source: 2010 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: In Europe, where forestry is ecologically more advanced, the noncommercial tree species are recognized as members of the native forest community, to be preserved as such, within reason.
items.zh: 在林业生态更为发达的欧洲，没有商业价值的树种被合理地看成是当地森林群落的成员，并得到相应的保护。
items.source: 2010 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It tends to ignore, and thus eventually to eliminate, many elements in the land community that lack commercial value, but that are essential to its healthy functioning.
items.zh: 这种保护系统往往忽视陆地群落中诸多缺乏商业价值但对其健康运行至关重要的物种，而最终导致它们的灭绝。
items.source: 2010 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: “Sustainability” has become a popular word these days, but to Ted Ning, the concept will always have personal meaning. Having endured a painful period of unsustainability in his own life made it clear to him that sustainability-oriented values must be expressed through everyday action and choice. Ning recalls spending a confusing year in the late 1990s selling insurance. He’d been through the dot-com boom and burst and, desperate for a job, signed on with a Boulder agency. It didn’t go well. “It was a really bad move because that’s not my passion,” says Ning, whose dilemma about the job translated, predictably, into a lack of sales. “I was miserable. I had so much anxiety that I would wake up in the middle of the night and stare at the ceiling. I had no money and needed the job. Everyone said, ‘Just wait, you’ll turn the corner, give it some time.’”
items.zh:
最近，“承受力”成了一个流行词汇，但对泰德·宁来说，他对这个词的涵义有自己的切身体会。在经历了一段难以承受的痛苦生活后，他清楚地认识到，以承受力为导向的价值观必须透过日常行动和抉择才能得以体现。

宁回忆起20世纪90年代后期他卖保险时那困窘的一年。在经历了互联网泡沫的繁荣与破灭后，他急需找到一份工作，因此与一家博尔德代理公司签了约。

但情况并不顺利。“那真是糟糕的一步，因为它根本激不起我的工作热情，”宁说。不出所料，工作上的进退维谷造成他销售业绩不佳。“我很痛苦，异常焦虑，以至于经常半夜醒来盯着天花板发呆。我没有钱，需要这份工作。大家都说，‘等等看，情况会有好转的，给它点时间。”
items.source: 2010 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: Allen’s contribution was to take an assumption we all share – that because we are not robots we therefore control our thoughts – and reveal its erroneous nature.
items.zh: 爱伦的贡献在于，他拿出“我们并非机器人，因此能掌控自己的思想”这一公认的假设，并揭示了其谬误所在。
items.source: 2011 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: “Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?”
items.zh: 尽管我们或许可以仅凭意识来维系“控制”这种错觉，现实中我们还是不断要面对一个问题：“我为什么不能让自己做这个或实现那个？”
items.source: 2011 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: This seems a justification for neglect of those in need, and a rationalization of exploitation, of the superiority of those at the top and the inferiority of those at the bottom.
items.zh: 这似乎是在为忽视贫困者的行为作辩护，为剥削、为社会上层人群的优越及社会底层人群的卑微找理由。
items.source: 2011 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: circumstances seem to be designed to bring out the best in us, and if we feel that we have been “wronged” then we are unlikely to begin a conscious effort to escape from our situation.
items.zh: 环境仿佛就是为了激发我们的最大潜能而设，如果我们觉得自己遭受了“不公”，就不太可能有意识地去努力摆脱自己的处境。
items.source: 2011 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The upside is the possibilities contained in knowing that everything is up to us; where before we were experts in the array of limitations, now we become authorities of what is possible.
items.zh: 其正面意义在于，了解了一切都取决于我们自己，即有了诸多可能；此前我们是谙熟各种局限的专家，现在我们成了驾驭各种可能性的权威。
items.source: 2011 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Who would have thought that, globally, the IT industry produces about the same volume of greenhouse gases as the world’s airlines do – roughly 2 percent of all CO2 emissions? Many everyday tasks take a surprising toll on the environment. A Google search can leak between 0.2 and 7.0 grams of CO2, depending on how many attempts are needed to get the “right” answer. To deliver results to its users quickly, then, Google has to maintain vast data centres around the world, packed with powerful computers. While producing large quantities of CO2, these computers emit a great deal of heat, so the centres need to be well air-conditioned, which uses even more energy. However, Google and other big tech providers monitor their efficiency closely and make improvements. Monitoring is the first step on the road to reduction, but there is much more to be done, and not just by big companies.
items.zh:
谁会想到信息技术行业产生的温室气体总量会与航空业不相上下，约占全球二氧化碳排放量的2%?

信息技术行业的许多日常工作对环境造成了意想不到的危害。每用谷歌搜索一次就会释放出0.2克至7.0克的二氧化碳，释放量的多少取决于使用者需要搜索多少次才能得到“正确”答案。为了把搜索结果迅速传输给用户，谷歌不得不在全世界范围内建立大型数据中心，并配备大功率计算机。除了排放大量二氧化碳，这些计算机还释放许多热量，因此数据中心还需要良好的空调环境，而这又会消耗更多的能量。

不过，谷歌和其他大型技术供应商已在密切监控其数据中心的工作效率并做出改进。监控只是减排的第一步，需要做的还有很多，而且这不单单是大公司的事情。
items.source: 2011 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: In physics, one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme, and seeks a theory of everything – a single generative equation for all we see.
items.zh: 在物理学领域，一种做法把这种寻求大同理论的冲动推向极端，试图寻找包含一切的理论——一个涵括我们所看到的一切的生成性公式。
items.source: 2012 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Here, Darwinism seems to offer justification, for if all humans share common origins, it seems reasonable to suppose that cultural diversity could also be traced to more constrained beginnings.
items.zh: 这里，达尔文学说似乎做出了证明，因为如果人类有着共同的起源，那么似乎就有理由认为文化的多样性也可以追溯到更为有限的起源。
items.source: 2012 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: To filter out what is unique from what is shared migh t enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
items.zh: 从共有特征中滤出独有特征，这使我们得以理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，并从进化或认知角度理解什么引导了它的走向。
items.source: 2012 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The second, by Joshua Greenberg, takes a more empirical approach to universality, identifying traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages, which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.
items.zh: 第二次努力——由乔舒亚·格林堡做出——采用更为经验主义的方法来研究语言的普遍性，确定了多种语言（尤其在语法词序方面）的共有特征，这些特征被认为是代表了由认知限制产生的倾向。
items.source: 2012 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Chomsky’s grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations.
items.zh: 乔姆斯基的语法应该显示出语言变化的模式，这些模式并不受语言谱系或贯穿谱系路径的影响；而格林堡式的普遍性则预言了特定的语法词序关系类型之间所存在的紧密互依性。
items.source: 2012 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: When people in developing countries worry about migration, they are usually concerned at the prospect of their best and brightest departure to Silicon Valley or to hospitals and universities in the developed world. These are the kind of workers that countries like Britain, Canada and Australia try to attract by using immigration rules that privilege college graduates. Lots of studies have found that well-educated people from developing countries are particularly likely to emigrate. A big survey of Indian households in 2004 found that nearly 40% of emigrants had more than a high-school education, compared with around 3.3% of all Indians over the age 25. This “brain drain” has long bothered policymakers in poor countries. They fear that it hurts their economies, depriving them of much-needed skilled workers who could have taught at their universities, worked in their hospitals and come up with clever new products for their factories to make.
items.zh:
发展中国家的人考虑移民时，通常关心的是到硅谷或发达国家的医院和大学里工作这样最美好最光明的前景。这些人正是英国、加拿大和澳大利亚等国家想要通过对大学毕业生提供优惠的移民条例来吸引的人才。

许多研究表明，发展中国家受过良好教育的人尤其可能移民。2004年对印度家庭的一项大规模调查表明，将近40%移居国外的人受过高中以上教育，而与之形成对比的是：全印度25岁以上受过高中以上教育的人约为3.3%。这种“人才流失”现象长期困扰着贫困国家的决策者。他们担心这会损害本国经济，使他们失去急需的熟练劳动者，这些人本可以留在国内在大学任教、在医院工作或设计新奇产品供工厂生产。
items.source: 2012 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: yet when one looks at the photographs of the gardens created by the homeless, it strikes one that, for all their diversity of styles, these gardens speak of various other fundamental urges, beyond that of decoration and creative expression .
items.zh: 然而，只要看看无家可归者创造的花园的照片，你就会意识到尽管样式各异，但这些花园除了表达（人类）装饰和创造的欲望之外，更体现了人类其他根本的强烈愿望。
items.source: 2013 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: A sacred place of peace, however crude it may be, is a distinctly human need, as opposed to shelter, which is a distinctly animal need.
items.zh: 安宁的圣地（体现的）是人类特有的需要，无论怎样疏于雕琢，它仍与遮风挡雨之所不同，后者（反映的）是动物特有的需要。
items.source: 2013 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The gardens of the homeless, which are in effect homeless gardens, introduce form into an urban environmen t where it either didn’t exist or was not discernible as such.
items.zh: 这种无家可归者的花园实质上是无定所的花园，它们把“形式”引入城市环境，而城市不境中原本要么没有这种“形式”，要么并没有把它当成“形式”看待。
items.source: 2013 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic.
items.zh: 我们大多数人通常把陷入精神颓丧归咎于某些心理疾病，直到有一天置身花园，才顿觉压抑感神奇地消失了。
items.source: 2013 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It is this implicit or explicit reference to nature that fully justifies the use of the word garden , though in a “liberated” sense, to describe these synthetic constructions.
items.zh: 虽然有“扩大词义外延”的意味，但正是这种对大自然或隐晦或明晰的参照让用“花园”一词来描述这些人造组合有了充分的根据。
items.source: 2013 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: I can pick a date from the past 53 years and know instantly where I was, what happened in the news and even the day of the week. I’ve been able to do this since I was four. I never feel overwhelmed with the amount of information my brain absorbs. My mind seems to be able to cope and the information is stored away neatly. When I think of a sad memory, I do what everybody does – try to put it to one side. I don’t think it’s harder for me just because my memory is clearer. Powerful memory doesn’t make my emotions any more acute or vivid. I can recall the day my grandfather died and the sadness I felt when we went to the hospital the day before. I also remember that the musical play Hair opened on Broadway on the same day – they both just pop into my mind in the same way.
items.zh:
在过去的53年中任意挑一天，我马上就能知道那天我在什么地方，新闻报道了什么，甚至那天是星期几。我从四岁开始就有这本事了。

我从来不会因为脑子吸收大量信息而受不了。我的脑子似乎能够应付，而且这些信息也储存得有条有理。当我回想起一件悲伤的事情时，我所做的和大家一样——尽量把它放到一边。我不觉得就因为我的记忆更清晰，我就会更难受。强大的记忆力并没有使我的情感更为强烈或更为鲜明。我能回想起我祖父去世的那一天，以及我们前一天去医院时我伤心的感觉。我同样记得，百老汇在同一天首演音乐剧《发》——这两件事在我脑海里突然出现的方式没什么两样。
items.source: 2013 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: It is also the reason why when we try to describe music with words, all we can do is articulate our reactions to it , and not grasp music itself .
items.zh: 这也解释了为什么当我们试图用语言去描述音乐的时候，充其量只能是说清楚自己的感受，而无法抓住音乐本身。
items.source: 2014 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: By all accounts he was a freethinking person, and a courageous one, and I find courage an essential quality for the understanding, let alone the performance, of his works .
items.zh: 总而言之，他是一个思想不受束缚的人，而且是一个富有勇气的人。我认为勇气是理解——更是演奏——其作品不可或缺的品格。
items.source: 2014 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Beethoven’s habit of increasing the volume with an extreme intensity and then abruptly following it with a sudden soft passage was only rarely used by composers before him .
items.zh: 贝多芬惯以超凡的力度加大音响，随后突然进入一个意想不到的柔和乐段，这种手法在前人的作品中极为罕见。
items.source: 2014 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Especially significant was his view of freedom, which, for him, was associated with the rights and responsibilities of the individual: he advocated freedom of thought and of personal expression.
items.zh: 尤具深意的是他的自由观，在他看来自由关系到个人的权利和责任：他主张思想和个人表达的自由。
items.source: 2014 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living .
items.zh: 苦难是不可避免的，但与之抗争的勇气正是生活的意义所在。对贝多芬的诸多作品，我们都可做此解读。
items.source: 2014 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Most people would define optimism as being endlessly happy, with a glass that’s perpetually half full. But that’s exactly the kind of false cheerfulness that positive psychologists wouldn’t recommend. “Healthy optimism means being in touch with reality,” says Tal Ben-Shahar, a Harvard professor. According to Ben-Shahar, realistic optimists are those who make the best of things that happen, but not those who believe everything happens for the best. Ben-Shahar uses three optimistic exercises. When he feels down – say, after giving a bad lecture – he grants himself permission to be human. He reminds himself that not every lecture can be a Nobel winner; some will be less effective than others. Next is reconstruction. He analyzes the weak lecture, learning lessons for the future about what works and what doesn’t. Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn’t matter.
items.zh:
大多数人都会把乐观定义为永远快乐，觉得杯子里总有半杯水。但这恰恰不是真正的快乐，积极心理学家们并不提倡。哈佛大学教授 Tal Ben-Shahar 说：“健康的乐观意味着不脱离现实。”按照 Ben-Shahar 的说法，现实的乐观主义者是那些不管发生什么事情都力求从中得到最大收获的人，而不是那些指望凡事都有最好结局的人。

Ben-Shahar 运用三种方法保持乐观。当他情绪低落时——比如说一次课没讲好——他宽容自己，承认自己是凡人。他提醒自己，不是每堂课都有获诺贝尔奖的水准；总会有一些课的效果不如别的课。第二种方法是回顾。他分析讲得不好的课，为以后汲取有用的经验和失败的教训。最后，还有视角问题，要认识到在宏大的生命长卷里，一堂课真的不算什么。
items.source: 2014 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: This movement, driven by powerful and diverse motivations, built a nation out of a wilderness and, by its nature, shaped the character and destiny of an uncharted continent .
items.zh: 在各种强大动机的推动下，这场迁移从荒野中造就了一个民族，并循其本质塑造了一片全新大陆的特点，决定了它的命运。
items.source: 2015 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The United States is the product of two principal forces – the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits.
items.zh: 合众国是两股主要力量作用的产物，一是具有不同思想、风俗和民族特点的欧洲各民族的迁入，二是一个新国家因改变了这些特性而产生的影响。
items.source: 2015 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes.
items.zh: 但是美洲特有地理条件的作用，不同族群间的相互影响，加上在一片荒蛮新大陆上维持旧大陆方式的巨大困难，所有这一切引起了意义深远的变化。
items.source: 2015 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The first shiploads of immigrants bound for the territory which is now the United States crossed the Atlantic more than a hundred years after the 15th-and-16th-century explorations of North America.
items.zh: 在十五、十六世纪的北美大陆探险过去一百多年后，首批满载移民驶向今天合众国这片疆土的船只横穿过了大西洋。
items.source: 2015 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The virgin forest with its richness and variety of trees was a real treasure-house which extended from Maine all the way down to Georgia.
items.zh: 郁郁葱葱、树种繁多的原始森林是一座从缅因一直向南绵延到佐治亚的天然宝库。
items.source: 2015 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Think about driving a route that’s very familiar. It could be your commute to work, a trip into town or the way home. Whichever it is, you know every twist and turn like the back of your hand. On these sorts of trips it’s easy to lose concentration on the driving and pay little attention to the passing scenery. The consequence is that you perceive that the trip has taken less time than it actually has. This is the well-travelled road effect: People tend to underestimate the time it takes to travel a familiar route. The effect is caused by the way we allocate our attention. When we travel down a well-known route, because we don’t have to concentrate much, time seems to flow more quickly. And afterwards, when we come to think back on it, we can’t remember the journey well because we didn’t pay much attention to it. So we assume it was shorter.
items.zh:
试想开车走一条非常熟悉的路。可以是上下班、进城或是回家的路。不管是哪条路，你对每一处曲曲弯弯都了如指掌。在这种路上，很容易不专注于驾驶，很少注意沿途的景色。结果你就觉得旅途所花的时间比实际的要短。

这就是熟路效应：人们走熟路时往往会低估所需的时间。

这种效应是由我们分配注意力的方式造成的。我们走很熟的路时，由于不必非常专注，时间似乎就过得快些。之后，我们回想起这段旅程时，由于当时没怎么注意，所以记得不很清楚。这样，我们就觉得时间短了。
items.source: 2015 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: We don’t have to learn how to be mentally healthy; it is built into us in the same way that our bodies know how to heal a cut or mend a broken bone.
items.zh: 我们不必学习如何保持心理健康；它是我们生来就有的，正如同我们的身体知道如何治愈伤口或修复断骨一样。
items.source: 2016 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Our mental health doesn’t really go anywhere; like the sun behind a cloud, it can be temporarily hidden from view, but it is fully capable of being restored in an instant.
items.zh: 心理健康并没有真的离开；宛如云朵后面的太阳，它虽然可能暂离我们的视线，但完全能在转瞬之间重现。
items.source: 2016 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain, and with unconditional love no matter who they are.
items.zh: 心理健康让我们在他人遇到困难时心怀同情，遭受苦痛时心怀善意，不论他们是谁（我们）都会心怀无条件的爱。
items.source: 2016 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Although mental health is the cure-all for living our lives, it is perfectly ordinary as you will see that it has been there to direct you through all your difficult decisions.
items.zh: 尽管心理健康是我们生活的万能灵药，但它又再寻常不过，因为你会发现，它一直在那里引领你完成所有艰难的抉择。
items.source: 2016 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: As you will come to see, knowing that mental health is always available and knowing to trust it allow us to slow down to the moment and live life happily .
items.zh: 你终会明白，懂得心理健康无时不在并懂得信赖它，这能让我们慢下来活在每一刻，快乐地生活着。
items.source: 2016 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The supermarket is designed to lure customers into spending as much time as possible within its doors. The reason for this is simple: The longer you stay in the store, the more stuff you’ll see, and the more stuff you see, the more you’ll buy. And supermarkets contain a lot of stuff. The average supermarket, according to the Food Marketing Institute, carries some 44,000 different items, and many carry tens of thousands more. The sheer volume of available choice is enough to send shoppers into a state of information overload. According to brain-scan experiments, the demands of so much decision-making quickly become too much for us. After about 40 minutes of shopping, most people stop struggling to be rationally selective, and instead begin shopping emotionally – which is the point at which we accumulate the 50 percent of stuff in our cart that we never intended buying.
items.zh: 超市的设计就是要诱使顾客尽可能久地待在店内。其理由很简单：你在店里逗留越久，看到的东西就越多，看到的东西越多，买的就越多。而超市里的东西多得很。按食品营销研究院所说，普通超市售卖约44,000种各式货品，而且许多超市的货品还要多出成千上万种。单是可供选择的货品数量就足以让购物者陷入信息超负荷的状态。根据大脑扫描实验，如此之大的决策量带来的负担会很快令我们无法承受。购物约40分钟后，大多数人就不再费心去理性选购，而是开始冲动购物了——就是从这一刻起，我们把本来根本没打算买的那一半东西堆进了购物车。
items.source: 2016 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: But even as the number of English speakers expands further there are signs that the global predominance of the language may fade within the foreseeable future.
items.zh: 尽管讲英语的人数在进一步增加，但有迹象显示这一语言的全球统治地位在可预见的未来可能会衰落。
items.source: 2017 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: His analysis should therefore end any self-contentedness among those who may believe that the global position of English is so stable that the young generations of the United Kingdom do not need additional language capabilities.
items.zh: 因此，他的分析会让一些人再也无法自满，这些人或许认为英语的全球地位十分稳固，从而英国的年轻人无需额外的语言能力。
items.source: 2017 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: many countries are introducing English into the primary-school curriculum but British schoolchildren and students do not appear to be gaining greater encouragement to achieve fluency in other languages .
items.zh: 许多国家都在把英语纳入小学课程，但英国的大、中、小学生却似乎没有得到更多的鼓励去熟练掌握其他语言。
items.source: 2017 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The changes identified by David Graddol all present clear and major challenges to the UK’s providers of English language teaching to people of other countries and to broader education business sectors.
items.zh: 大卫·格拉多尔所指出的这些变化都对向其他国家的人提供英语教学的英国个人和组织机构乃至更广泛的教育产业领域构成明确的、重大的挑战。
items.source: 2017 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It gives a basis to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English, a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment.
items.zh: 它为旨在促进英语学习和使用的所有组织机构提供了一个基础，该基础用于规划应对由一种或许会很不一样的运作环境所带来的各种可能。
items.source: 2017 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: My dream has always been to work somewhere in an area between fashion and publishing. Two years before graduating from secondary school, I took a sewing and design course thinking that I would move on to a fashion design course. However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me. Before applying for university I told everyone that I would study journalism, because writing was, and still is, one of my favourite activities. But, to be honest, I said it, because I thought that fashion and me together was just a dream – I knew that no one could imagine me in the fashion industry at all! So I decided to look for some fashion-related courses that included writing. This is when I noticed the course “Fashion Media & Promotion.”
items.zh: 我的梦想一直是在时尚和出版之间的领域工作。中学毕业前两年，我选了一门缝纫与设计课，心想以后会接着修一门时装设计课。然而，在学习那门课程期间，我意识到自己在这个领域不够出色，日后不足以与其他有创造力的人士竞争，因此我认定，这条路不适合我。申请上大学之前，我跟所有人说我要学新闻，因为写作曾经是——现在依然是——我最喜欢的活动之一。可是，说实话，当时我那么说是因为我觉得时尚和我结缘仅仅是个梦——我知道，别人根本无法想象我能进入时尚行业！于是，我决定找些含有写作的与时尚相关的课程。就在这个时候，我注意到了“时尚传媒与推广”这门课。
items.source: 2017 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: By the date of his birth Europe was witnessing the passing of the religious drama, and the creation of new forms under the incentive of classical tragedy and comedy.
items.zh: 他出生时，欧洲正见证着宗教剧的消亡，以及在古典悲剧和喜剧启发之下新型戏剧形式的诞生。
items.source: 2018 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: no boy who went to a grammar school could be ignorant that the drama was a form of literature which gave glory to Greece and Rome and might yet bring honor to England.
items.zh: 凡是文法学校的学童就不会不知道，戏剧这种文学形式曾给希腊和罗马带来辉煌，或也将为英国带来荣耀。
items.source: 2018 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood.
items.zh: 但是专业剧团在他们的固定剧场里蓬勃发展，而大学里有文学抱负的人们迅速转向这些剧场，视其为一种谋生手段。
items.source: 2018 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: A native literary drama had been created, its alliance with the public playhouses established, and at least some of its great traditions had been begun .
items.zh: 一种本土的文学戏剧已然形成，它与公共剧场的联盟已然建立，它的伟大传统中至少有一部分也已然开启。
items.source: 2018 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived.
items.zh: 要明白当时的戏剧活动是何等繁荣，我们还必须记住，大量剧作都已散失，恐怕没有哪位知名作家的全部作品幸存至今。
items.source: 2018 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: A fifth grader gets a homework assignment to select his future career path from a list of occupations. He ticks “astronaut” but quickly adds “scientist” to the list and selects it as well. The boy is convinced that if he reads enough, he can explore as many career paths as he likes. And so he reads – everything from encyclopedias to science fiction novels. He reads so passionately that his parents have to institute a “no reading policy” at the dinner table. That boy was Bill Gates, and he hasn’t stopped reading yet – not even after becoming one of the most successful people on the planet. Nowadays, his reading material has changed from science fiction and reference books: recently, he revealed that he reads at least 50 nonfiction books a year. Gates chooses nonfiction titles because they explain how the world works. “Each book opens up new avenues of knowledge to explore”, Gates says.
items.zh:
一个五年级学生拿到一份家庭作业，要求从一份职业列表中选择将来的职业道路。他勾选了“宇航员”，但很快在表上添加了“科学家”，并将它也选上。这个男孩子相信，只要他读得够多，那么他想探索多少职业道路都可以。于是，他就这样读书——从百科全书到科幻小说，什么都看。他如饥似渴地读书，以至于他的父母不得不立下一条吃饭时“不许看书的规矩”。

那个男孩就是比尔盖茨，他没有停止阅读，甚至在他成为这个星球上最成功的人士之一后，仍旧没有停下来。现在，他的阅读材料已经不再是科幻小说和工具书了：最近据他所说，他一年内至少读了50本非科幻小说。比尔盖茨选择非科幻小说类书籍，是因为这类书籍解释了世界是如何运作的。“每本书都开辟了新的知识探索渠道。”盖茨说。
items.source: 2018 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: There is a great deal of this kind of nonsense in the medical journals which, when taken up by broadcasters and the lay press, generates both health scares and short-lived dietary enthusiasms.
items.zh: 医学期刊中充斥着这类无稽之谈，这些东西一经广播和非专业报刊传播，就会引起健康方面的恐慌和对某些饮食的短暂追捧。
items.source: 2019 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: nowadays anyone applying for a research post has to have published twice the number of papers that would have been required for the same post only 10 years ago.
items.zh: 今天，任何一个科研岗位的申请者需要发表文章的数量比短短十年前申报同一岗位时整整翻了一番。
items.source: 2019 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Attempts have been made to curb this tendency, for example, by trying to incorporate some measure of quality as well as quantity into the assessment of an applicant’s papers.
items.zh: 为遏制这一倾向已经采取了若干措施，比如在评定岗位申请者的论文时，尝试引入一项兼顾数量和质量的评估指标。
items.source: 2019 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: This would be reasonable if it were not for the fact that scientists can easily arrange to cite themselves in their future publications, or get associates to do so for them in return for similar favours.
items.zh: 要不是因为科研人员轻易就能在将来的论文里自我引用，或找同行引用以回报自己提供的类似好处，这项措施本该是合理的。
items.source: 2019 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: If we are serious about ensuring that our science is both meaningful and reproducible, we must ensure that our institutions encourage that kind of science.
items.zh: 如果我们真想保证我们的科研既有意义又可复制，就必须确保我们的体制能激励这样的科研。
items.source: 2019 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It is easy to underestimate English writer James Herriot. He had such a pleasant, readable style that one might think that anyone could imitate it. How many times have I heard people say, “I could write a book. I just haven’t the time.” Easily said. Not so easily done. James Herriot, contrary to popular opinion, did not find it easy in his early days of, as he put it, “having a go at the writing game”. While he obviously had an abundance of natural talent, the final, polished work that he gave to the world was the result of years of practicing, re-writing and reading. Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way, but these made him all the more determined to succeed. Everything he achieved in life was earned the hard way and his success in the literary field was no exception.
items.zh: 英国作家詹姆斯·海里厄特容易被人低估。他的作品风格欢快易读，让人觉得谁都可以模仿。有多少次我都听人说：“我也能写书。我只是没那时间。”说起来轻巧，做起来就没那么简单了。和一般人的想法相反，用詹姆斯·海里厄特的话说，在“玩写作这种游戏”之初，他可没觉得很容易。虽然他显然天分极高，但他最终呈现给世人的精湛作品却是多年写作练习、不断重写和阅读的结果。跟大多数作家一样，他一路走来也不得不遭受了许多失望和被拒之苦，但这些更坚定了他要成功的决心。他一生的所有成就都是艰苦努力的结果，他在文学领域的成功也不例外。
items.source: 2019 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: with the Church’s teachings and ways of thinking being eclipsed by the Renaissance,the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged, leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories.
items.zh: 随着教会的教义和思维模式因文艺复兴而暗淡无光，中世纪和现代两个历史时期之间架起了桥梁，进而通向了崭新和未探索过的知识领域。
items.source: 2020 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
items.zh: 在他们的每项发现之前，当时的许多思想家一直沿袭着更加古老的思维模式，其中包括认为地球处于宇宙中心的地心说。
items.source: 2020 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress. this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore.
items.zh: 尽管教会屡屡打压这些新一代的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙运行原理的阐释还是不断涌现，其速度让世人再也无法视而不见。
items.source: 2020 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era - the Age of Reason.
items.zh: 当很多人承担起试图将理性思维和科学思想融入大千世界这一责任时，文艺复兴即告结束，新的时代从此开启。
items.source: 2020 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase ‘sapere aude’ or ‘dare to know’,
items.zh: 拉丁语短语“sapere aude”即“敢于求知”，准确地概括了这类寻求知识和理解已知信息的行为。
items.source: 2020 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It's almost impossible to go through life without experiencing some kind of failure. But, the wonderful thing about failure is that it's entirely up to us to decide how to look at it. We can choose to see failure as “the end of the world”. Or, we can look at failure as the incredible learning experience that it often is. Every time we fail at something, we can choose to look for the lesson we’re meant to learn. These lessons are very important; they’re how we grow, and how we keep from making that same mistake again. Failures stop us only if we let them. Failure can also teach us things about ourselves that we would never have learned otherwise. For instance, failure can help you discover how strong a person you are. Failing at something can help you discover your truest friends, or help you find unexpected motivation to succeed.
items.zh:
人的一生几乎不可能不经受某些失败。但是，失败的奇妙之处在于，它完全取决于我们如何看待它。

我们可以把失败看作“世界末日”。我们也可以将它视为极好的学习经历，它常常就是如此。每一次失败时，我们都可以从中找寻应该吸取的教训。这些教训非常重要；它们使我们成长，也使我们不再犯同样的错误。只有任由失败阻止我们，我们才会被它阻止。

失败也能教给我们一些有关我们自己的事情，没有失败，这些事情我们永远不会了解。比如，失败可以帮你发现自己有多么坚强。失败可以帮你发现最真诚的朋友，或者帮你找到意想不到的成功动力。
items.source: 2020 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war.
items.zh: 战争结束时，那些社会的高校入学率为相应年龄人群的 3%—5%,这一水平在战前数十年里大致保持稳定。
items.source: 2021 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.
items.zh: 那些社会中对于接受高等教育的需求增长了，其范围扩大到战前没有考虑过上大学的群体和社会阶层。
items.source: 2021 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: in many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven , eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s.
items.zh: 在许多西欧国家，高等院校的学生数量在二十世纪六十年代期间五年翻了一番，之后经过七、八或十年的时间到七十年代中期又翻了一番。
items.source: 2021 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study , they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty.
items.zh: 当绝大多数新教职员工是刚刚完成研究生学业的年轻人时，他们就在很大程度上确立了所在院系的学术生活规范。
items.source: 2021 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.
items.zh: 高增长率增加了学术创新的可能性；同时也弱化了在稳定时期或缓慢增长时期接纳教师和学生进入学者群体的那些形式和流程。
items.source: 2021 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection,laughter, and warmth. While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn’t expect. In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them. On average, participants who followed this instruction felt better than those who had been told to stand or sit in silence. The researchers also argued that when we shy away from casual interactions with strangers, it is often due to a misplaced anxiety that they might not want to talk to us. Much of the time,however, this belief is false.As it turns out, many people are actually perfectly willing to talk — and may even be flattered to receive your attention.
items.zh:
我们往往认为，朋友和家人是我们获得情感归属、欢乐和温暖的最主要来源。虽然这很有可能正确，但是，研究人员最近也发现，与陌生人交流实际上会给我们带来意想不到的好心情以及归属感。

在一系列的研究中，研究人员让芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者与身旁的人搭讪。平均而言，遵照这一指示的参与者比那些被要求安静地站着或坐着的参与者感觉更好。研究人员还认为，我们之所以避而不与陌生人闲聊，通常是由于不必要的忧虑，担心他们可能不想和我们说话。但是，在大多数时候，这种想法是错误的。正如研究结果所示，许多人其实非常愿意交谈——甚至可能会因为受到你的关注而格外高兴。
items.source: 2021 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them.
items.zh: 这也是一场编码者和破译者之间的较量，即便对熟读这段历史的很多人来说，这也是闻所未闻的。
items.source: 2022 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of one George Scovell , an officer in British headquarters.
items.zh: 附录列出了从西班牙的法国驻军截获的许多加密文件，将其破译的是英军司令部一位名叫乔治·斯科威尔的军官。
items.source: 2022 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.
items.zh: 他无法详细分析这位无名军官对那场国家间的大战是否做过什么贡献，也确实无法告诉我们多少此人的个人情况。
items.source: 2022 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on.
items.zh: 拿破仑战争期间可能有过很多间谍和情报官，但要找到真正由他们提供或处理过的材料，通常却非常困难。
items.source: 2022 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society.
items.zh: 正如密码破译对于那场争夺西班牙的战争有着更广泛的意义，他谋求晋升的种种努力也充分说明了当时英国社会的现实。
items.source: 2022 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Although we try our best, sometimes our paintings rarely turn out as originally planned. Changes in the light, the limitations of your painting materials, and the lack of experience and technique mean that what you start out trying to achieve may not come to life the way that you expected. Although this can be frustrating and disappointing, it turns out that this can actually be good for you. Unexpected results have two benefits: you pretty quickly learn to deal with disappointment, and realise that when one door closes, another opens. You also quickly learn to adapt and come up with creative solutions to the problems the painting presents, and thinking outside the box will become your second nature. In fact, creative problem-solving skills are incredibly useful in daily life, with which you’re more likely to be able to find a solution when a problem arises.
items.zh:
虽然我们竭尽所能，但有时我们的画作很少符合最初的计划。光线的改变、绘画材料的限制以及经验和技巧的不足，都意味着起初想要达到的效果未必能够如你所愿地呈现出来。

尽管这难免让人沮丧失望，但结果其实可能对你有益。意料之外的结果有两个好处：你会很快学会处理失望情绪，并意识到当一扇门关上时，另一扇门就会打开。你也会很快学会适应，想出创造性的解决方案，解决画作中出现的问题，跳出常规进行思考会成为你的第二天性。

事实上，创造性解决问题的技能在日常生活中极为有用，有了这种技能，发生问题时你就更有可能找到解决办法。
items.source: 2022 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: AI can also be used to identify the lifestyle choices of customers regarding their hobbies, favourite celebrities, and fashions to provide unique content in marketing messages put out through social media.
items.zh: 人工智能也可用于识别客户的生活方式选择，包括他们的兴趣爱好、最喜爱的名人和时尚风格，进而可以通过社交媒体向客户投放针对性的营销内容。
items.source: 2023 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Some believe that AI is negatively impacting on the marketer’s role by reducing creativity and removing jobs, but they are aware that it is a way of reducing costs and creating new information.
items.zh: 有些人认为，人工智能通过降低创新能力和取消工作岗位正在对营销人员的角色产生负面影响，但他们也意识到这是一种削减成本和创造新内容的方式。
items.source: 2023 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Algorithms used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns, especially as no-one is quite sure what the outcomes of using AI to interact with customers will be.
items.zh: 用于模拟人类互动的算法正在引发许多这样的担忧，尤其是因为没有人能十分确定使用人工智能与客户互动会带来什么结果。
items.source: 2023 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: If customers are not willing to share data, AI will be starved of essential information and will not be able to function effectively or employ machine learning to improve its marketing content and communication.
items.zh: 如果客户不愿分享数据，人工智能便会缺乏必要信息，以至于无法有效地运作，也无法运用机器学习来改进其营销内容和传播策略。
items.source: 2023 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The non-intrusive delivery of the marketing messages in a way that is sensitive to the needs of target customers is one of the critical challenges to the digital marketer.
items.zh: 用一种对目标客户的需求保持敏感的方式非侵入性地传递营销信息是数字营销人员面临的关键挑战之一。
items.source: 2023 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: In the late 18th century, William Wordsworth became famous for his poems about nature. And he was one of the founders of a movement called Romanticism, which celebrated the wonders of the natural world. Poetry is powerful. Its energy and rhythm can capture a reader, transport them to another world and make them see things differently. Through carefully selected words and phrases, poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring. No one knows for sure when poetry began but it has been around for thousands of years, even before people could write. It was a way to tell stories and pass down history. It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud. Poems really come to life when they are recited. This can also help with understanding them too, because the rhythm and sounds of the words become clearer.
items.zh:
十八世纪末，威廉·华兹华斯以其关于自然的诗歌而闻名遐迩。而他也是浪漫主义运动的缔造者之一，该运动颂扬自然世界的奇迹。

诗歌富有感染力。它的能量与韵律可以捕获读者的心，带他们去到另一个世界，让他们以不同的视角来看待事物。凭借精心挑选的字词和短语，诗歌或夸张戏剧，或诙谐幽默，或优美迷人，或动人心魄，或振奋人心。

没有人确切地知道诗歌于何时兴起，但是它已经存在了数千年，甚至在人们会书写之前就已存在。它是一种讲述故事和传承历史的方式。它与音乐密切相关，即使被书写出来，也通常是为了大声朗诵而创作。诗歌在被吟诵时才真正鲜活起来。吟诵也有助于理解诗歌，因为字词的韵律和发音会更加清晰明确。
items.source: 2023 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: They sometimes travel more than sixty miles to find food or water, and are very good at working out where other elephants are—even when they are out of sight.
items.zh: 它们有时会行走 60 多英里去寻找食物或水源，而且非常擅长判断其他大象的位置——即使后者位于其视线以外。
items.source: 2024 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.
items.zh: 研究人员确信，这些大象总是能够很确切地知道它们与所有所需资源之间的相对位置，因此除了走熟路，它们还能走捷径。
items.source: 2024 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: One possibility was that they merely used their eyes and tried out the plants they found, but that would probably result in a lot of wasted time and energy, not least because their eyesight is actually not very good.
items.zh: 其中一种可能的解释是，它们仅靠眼睛来寻觅它们要试吃的植物，但这种情况可能会浪费大量的时间和精力，尤其是因为它们的视力实际上并不怎么好。
items.source: 2024 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The volatile chemicals produced by plants can be carried a long way, and they are very characteristic: Each plant or tree has its own particular odor signature.
items.zh: 植物所产生的挥发性化学物质可以扩散很远的距离，而且这些物质还极具独特性：每种植物或树木都有自己特有的气味特征。
items.source: 2024 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: The experiment showed that elephants may well use smell to identify patches of trees that are good to eat, and secondly to assess the quality of the trees within each patch.
items.zh: 实验表明，大象完全可以用嗅觉来辨别适宜食用的树丛，并评估每片树丛内树木的质量。
items.source: 2024 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: With the smell of coffee and fresh bread floating in the air, stalls bursting with colourful vegetables and tempting cheeses, and the buzz of friendly chats, farmers’ markets are a feast for the senses. They also provide an opportunity to talk to the people responsible for growing or raising your food, support your local economy and pick up fresh seasonal produce—all at the same time. Farmers’ markets are usually weekly or monthly events, most often with outdoor stalls, which allow farmers or producers to sell their food directly to customers. The size or regularity of markets can vary from season to season, depending on the area’s agricultural calendar, and you’re likely to find different produce on sale at different times of the year. By cutting out the middleman, the farmers secure more profit for their produce. Shoppers also benefit from seeing exactly where—and to who—their money is going.
items.zh:
空气中弥漫着咖啡和新鲜面包的香味，摊位上摆满了五颜六色的蔬菜和令人垂涎的奶酪，友好的交谈声嘈杂而又喧闹着，农贸市场就是一场感官盛宴。它们还提供了一个机会，让人们既能与提供食物的种植者和养殖者交谈，又能（在经济上）支持地方经济，同时还能买到新鲜便宜的时令农产品。

农贸市场通常是每周或每月举行一次的活动，其中最常见的是户外摊位，这使得农民或生产者能够将他们的食物直接售卖给顾客。农贸市场的规模或规律因季节而异，这取决于当地的农历，你很可能会发现在一年中的不同时间点里会有不同的农产品在出售。通过省去中间商环节，农民可以从自己的农产品中获取更多的利润。顾客也能从中受益，因为他们能够清楚地看见自己的钱花在了哪里、付给了谁。
items.source: 2024 考研英语二 Section III Translation

items.en: Recent decades have seen science move into a convention where engagement in the subject can only be done through institutions, such as a university.
items.zh: 近几十年来，科学界已经形成了一种惯例，即对科学的参与只能通过大学等机构来实现。
items.source: 2025 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: But by utilising the natural curiosity of the general public it is possible to overcome many of these challenges by engaging non-scientists directly in the research process.
items.zh: 但是，借助公众与生俱来的求知欲，让非科学家们直接参与研究过程，就有可能克服许多这样的挑战。
items.source: 2025 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
items.zh: 科学家们采用了各种各样的方式让公众参与他们的研究，比如将数据分析做成在线游戏或者将样本采集做成智能手机应用程序。
items.source: 2025 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.
items.zh: 这些群体属于快速扩张的生物科技社会运动的一部分，在这场运动中，公民科学家和专业科学家试图将科学发现带离研究机构，让任何有热情的人都能参与其中。
items.source: 2025 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension

items.en: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting.
items.zh: 这些中心汇聚资源、通力合作、打破常规思维，并围绕难题找到解决措施和方法，为了科学而探索科学，不受传统上在正式环境中工作的限制。
items.source: 2025 考研英语一 Section II Reading Comprehension
